rows.notes: Body is a legacy Excel .xls workbook, not JSON or delimited text: aextract_data picks one of 13 static ir.eia.gov/wpsr/pswNN.xls paths by category (WpsrFileMap, constants.py:119-132) and download_excel_file (utils/helpers.py:23) GETs bytes into pd.ExcelFile(BytesIO). transform (petroleum_status_report.py:177-206) reads named sheets with two-row headers (header=[1,2], skiprows=3, nrows=3 region reads), melts symbol columns into date/symbol/value rows, derives title/unit/table/order from header text (regex 'Data N:' rewrite, unit split), filters start/end client-side. Endpoints=1 per run (file chosen by category branch). UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: legacy_xls_binary_decoder -- xlsx_decoder/sheet_region_parse presume OOXML zip workbooks; WPSR files are BIFF8 OLE2 .xls needing xlrd-class decoding, a different decoder than any existing key names.

JSON api.eia.gov/v2/steo/data/ (api_key query param, require_credentials path at line 119); symbols (caller list or SteoTableMap[table] roster) are deduped and chunked 10 per URL as repeated facets[seriesId][] params, gathered with asyncio (fanout, lines 153-177, 217). Rows come from res['response']['data']; when total>5000 the same URL is re-fetched in a while loop bumping &offset by 5000 (lines 196-214). Date params resampled per frequency (monthly YYYY-MM / quarterly YYYY-QX via resample_to_quarter / annual YYYY, lines 132-150). transform: period->date cast, Categorical symbol order + sort_values, derived order/table columns; EiaShortTermEnergyOutlookData.__alias_dict__ renames period/seriesId/seriesDescription (lines 90-94). One path => endpoints=1; results concatenated, no cross-request join. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: query_param_offset_pagination -- body_offset_pagination presumes paging fields in a request body; EIA STEO paginates via GET URL query offset/length, which no existing key describes.
